title: VMime through 0.9.2 contains an integer underflow in the uuEncoder::decode function that allows remote attackers to…
description: VMime versions through 0.9.2 have an integer underflow vulnerability in the uuEncoder::decode function. This flaw allows remote attackers to craft uuencoded MIME parts in emails that trigger a stack-based buffer overflow. Specifically, sending a uuencoded line with a length character 'b' that is not a 'begin' line can corrupt stack memory, potentially crashing the application or enabling code execution.
